messages.content: You know, now that I think about it, I left my phone charger at the cabin—again. Might be a long night if the power flickers. Hope the fire alarm isn’t too opinionated. Talk Sunday!
"Don't worry about the charger for now—we'll make do with whatever we have! Enjoy your night, and I'm excited to hear the full saga on Sunday!"
True—half the fun is improvising with what’s on hand. If the lanterns die, we’ll just tell ghost stories by firelight. See you Sunday!
"That sounds like a wonderfully atmospheric plan! Enjoy the storytelling under the firelight, and I'll be ready to hear the saga this Sunday! Have a wonderful rest of your day!"
Thanks! I’ll probably end up roasting marshmallows and overthinking the plot of my own campfire tale. Rest of your day too—hope it’s full of small, quiet magic.

result.content: "It sounds like a wonderfully cozy plan! Enjoy the marshmallow-roasting and the 'overthinking' of your campfire tale. Have a truly wonderful day! I hope your day is filled with small, quiet magic!"
